T: Pick the fish course at your own risk.
D: A former pilot with a drinking problem has to land a plane when the crew gets food poisoning.
P: Serve the mains right after the fish course takes out the crew.
S: Prawns on shredded iceberg with tomato and horseradish sauce, row one before the fish course

Cooked prawns on shredded iceberg in a glass, with a tomato and horseradish cocktail sauce and a lemon wedge on the rim. Peel 600g cooked prawns, leaving a few tails on for the rims. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of Worcestershire. Shred half an iceberg lettuce into 4 glasses, pile in the prawns, spoon over the sauce and hang a prawn and a lemon wedge on each rim.
Flight deck cheddar and onion puffs
Puff pastry squares with slow cooked onion and sharp cheddar, green grapes on the side

Puff pastry squares topped with slow cooked onion and sharp cheddar, baked golden and served warm with green grapes. Slice 2 brown onions thinly and cook slowly in 20g butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 6 squares each and lay them on a lined tray. Spoon the onion into the middle of each square and top with 150g grated sharp cheddar. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with 300g green grapes on the side, airline style.
M: Seared sirloin in peppercorn cream, mashed potato and steamed green beans
Sirloin seared hard, rested, peppercorn sauce, mashed potato and green beans, served on an airline-style tray.
Beef and pork lasagne, the safe choice when dinner is steak or fish

Slow-simmered beef and pork ragù layered with pasta sheets, nutmeg béchamel and mozzarella, baked until bubbling and golden at the edges. Brown 500g beef mince and 250g pork mince, add 1 diced onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick and 2 garlic cloves, then 125ml red wine, 700ml passata and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Simmer 2 hours. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g flour, whisk in 700ml milk and cook until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Layer ragù, fresh lasagne sheets and béchamel three times in a dish, top with 200g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20 minutes before cutting.
W: Baked cheesecake with sour cream, cut into little squares
Baked New York cheesecake in a slab tin, cut into neat squares, a cherry on each.
twice-baked almond and orange with small espressos and cream, crumbs everywhere but his mouth

Twice-baked almond and orange biscotti, crisp enough to dunk, served with small cups of espresso topped with a spoon of whipped cream. Whisk 2 eggs with 150g caster sugar, then mix in 250g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, the zest of 1 orange and 100g whole almonds. Shape into 2 logs on a lined tray and bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice 1cm thick on an angle and bake again at 150C for 10 minutes a side. Brew 4 espressos and top each with a spoon of whipped cream.
K: Wrong week to quit espresso martini
Vodka, coffee liqueur and espresso shaken over ice. Looks like I picked the wrong week to quit.

Espresso shaken hard with vodka, three coffee beans. Brew 4 shots of espresso and cool for 5 minutes. Add the espresso, 160ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 20ml sugar syrup to a shaker full of ice. Shake very hard for 15 seconds to build the foam. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and float 3 coffee beans on each.
